This excerpt is from a book published in the 1800s about democracy in the United States.

Which selection demonstrates Alexis de Tocqueville's belief that U.S. citizens are free to pursue economic opportunities without much interference?

options.label: A
options.text: you are stunned by a kind of [commotion]

options.label: B
options.text: voices demand the immediate satisfaction of their social wants

options.label: C
options.text: the election of a representative is going on

options.label: D
options.text: American Union has no enemies to contend with

options.label: E
options.text: boundless field to human activity, and inexhaustible materials for industry
